attributes.board_name: Medical Licensing Board of Indiana (Indiana Professional Licensing Agency)

rules.alternatives: No general CME hour requirement is listed for physician license renewal. The former 2-hour opioid prescribing/opioid abuse CE for controlled substance registration (CSR) renewal expired on July 1, 2025 (IC 35-48-3-3.5).
rules.notes: One board for MDs and DOs. Active licenses renew before October 31 of odd-numbered years. No CME requirement appears on the Board's licensing pages; statute text (IC 25-22.5) not read directly, so confirm before publishing.
